messages:
Mika: Big shoutout to Carlos and June for the evening bagel rescue. Someone forgot the plates and they improvised with cutting boards and a heroic tupperware stack. Demo morale restored. :bagel: :heart:

Carlos: It was a team sport. Also kudos to Rita who found the extra butter in the storage closet. Crisis averted. :butter:

June: We should add 'emergency cutlery' to the meeting checklist. Also leaving a tiny sticky note on the fridge: 'Bagel rescuers = legends'.

Rita: Happy to help! Also noting that the lost-and-found now hosts more Tupperwares than mystery socks. :laughing:

kudos-bot: +1 Carlos, +1 June, +1 Rita. Reaction :tada: added by 4 people. Thread pinned to #random for the day.

Mika: Love the improvisation. Suggestion: mini gratitude jar in the kitchen for one-line kudos so people see these moments. Thanks again everyone! :clap:
